interface.shortDescription: Track European Parliament procedures, MEPs, votes, documents, speeches, and questions via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Follow legislative procedures through European Parliament records, find MEPs and their memberships, and inspect plenary roll-call votes. Search adopted texts and speeches, retrieve parliamentary documents and questions, and discover the reference codes used by the Parliament's free open-data API.
